provenance.source_document: BEA Mer Rapport d'enquête technique: Abordage survenu le 7 octobre 2018 entre le roulier Ulysse et le porte-conteneurs CSL Virginia (2019)
source_devices: CROSS La Garde coastal radar logs
provenance.disclaimer: All waypoints represent verified historical investigative evidence from official BEA Mer casualty records. No artificial or synthetic intermediate points have been added.

waypoints.source_reference: BEA Mer Report §1.5, CROSS coastal radar track
waypoints.notes: Underway on steady transit course 172° at full sea speed (19 kts)

waypoints.source_reference: BEA Mer Report §1.5, CROSS radar and VDR track log
waypoints.notes: Maintaining course 172° and 19 kts towards northern Corsica passage

waypoints.source_reference: BEA Mer Report §1.5.3, VDR radar capture analysis
waypoints.notes: CSL Virginia radar echo detected on S-band radar at ~2.7 NM (CPA=0 NM). Officer of watch distracted on personal telephone behind chart curtain.

waypoints.source_reference: BEA Mer Report §1.5.4, VDR optical and audio collision recording
waypoints.notes: Collision impact into starboard side of CSL Virginia. Speed drops abruptly from 19.0 kts to 0 kts. Bow penetrates 8 meters into hull.
Both vessels locked together at anchor position; engines stopped; pollution begins escaping from breached tank #3.
